about_the_game:
"Nowhere to Run" is an action/adventure interactive film, packed with choices that actually matter. 

Embark on a journey with Lucy and help her escape the desert before she gets caught by her abductor. Find out what's hidden in the desert, meet the old lady and discover her secrets, and who knows, maybe save somebodies life?

In this high stakes, non-linear independent film you decide what happens next. Will you be able to save Lucy from all the dangers that the desert hides? Or will you try to find all the potential way she could die? It's up to you!

Nowhere to Run is a film written and directed by Piotr Matyja, starring Kirsten Schaffer, Hunt Mallory, Sara Gellert, Jennifer Collins and Michael Profunato. 

Point System

Throughout the game you will interact with multiple characters and your choices will impact the relationships Lucy has with them. You'll also be able to collect items that unlock unique paths and additional features of the film.

Features

• Live action interactive film, with over 120 choices and 18 unique endings.
• Timed choices, mini games and hidden features.
• Point System that influences the story as you play.
• Real-time Personality Trait Tracking that evolves based on your choices.
• Skip Scene button and Story Map representing the choices you've made.
